extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors who want to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating or locating a Wikipedia article (here: 'Comedy album chart 2'), including account requirements, searching for existing coverage, handling title variants, and checking deletion or visibility issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or autoconfirmed you cannot create a new page; create an account and reach autoconfirmed status (per Wikipedia policy) before attempting to create the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page directly, submit a draft via the article wizard or use the community mechanisms to request creation so experienced editors can review and help.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Comedy album chart 2" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for alternative titles or spellings before creating a new article to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages linking to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can reveal related content, redirects, or whether the topic is covered elsewhere under a different name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent creation visibility and purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect a recent creation isn't showing, either wait a short time or use the purge function to refresh the page cache.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify different capitalizations and, if appropriate, create a redirect from common variants to the canonical article title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log and related documentation to understand deletion reasons and whether the content can be restored or reworked to meet policy.
